description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the MongoThingsSearchUpdaterPersistence class, which provides MongoDB-specific persistence logic for something called 'ThingsSearchUpdater'. It includes methods for retrieving policy reference tags, outdated thing IDs, and purging data within a namespace, utilizing reactive streams and MongoDB client libraries.

classes.name: MongoThingsSearchUpdaterPersistence
classes.description: MongoDB-specific implementation of the ThingsSearchUpdaterPersistence interface, handling persistence operations related to 'thing search' updates.

methods.name: getPolicyReferenceTags
methods.description: Retrieves policy reference tags based on a map of policy revisions, returning a reactive source stream.

methods.name: getOutdatedThingIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of outdated 'things' associated with a specific policy tag.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Marks all documents within a namespace as deleted by setting a delete timestamp.
